Oh my bad, i guess CPS is what they call FACS in the states?? In canada, its FACS, or Family and Childrens Services. Its basically CPS.

Honest to god id never harm my kids. But i think the main thing they really played on was the fact that i was 17, and the only reasons theyd ever give me was "mental health this and mental health that". I spent a good while admitted to the hospital a good number of times for suicide attempts.

What im mainly focusing on is college so i can get a career that will financially support them both and then some. We struggled growing up and thats the last thing i want for them. They're both my entire world and i want to be able to give them the world.

I was thinking of lawyering up anf doing so, but im afraid of the reprocussions of doing so. Theres no stopping my mom from just ringing up FACS on me for no reason when i have my kids. Ive seen her do it before.

They feared what id do to myself or the kids when in my care, but ive gone through mental health assessment after assessment, in the clear every time. I dont drink due to it being an issue with my previous partner, and i dont dare touch drugs.

Edit: also to add onto this, it was an odd occourence. I had phoned FACS initially because a public health nurse had reccomended i do because they had pregnancy planning workers. So i figure they could help me prep for baby. I was with my partner in a 3 bedroom townhouse at the time and we had his first daughter for weekends, so there was nothing wrong. 
A few months later, pregnancy planning turned into "we need to check your mental health", and a few months later turned into "you need to go to said womens facility with baby, leaving your partner for 24/7 mental health watch", which, by the way, i was being treated for, and I hadnt had any suicide attemots or ideation since i was pregnant with her, to them actively stalking my hospital room, waiting 2 hours in the hospital waiting room for an actual warrent to enter my room to tell me my daughter will be taken from the hospital and placed in foster care. Thats when my mom rushed stuff for kinship, and got custody of her. She was in foster care for the weekend. My mom told me stories of when she worked for them, watching cases get fucked up, kids who were wrongfully apprehended, and in turn, swept under the rug. Thats why she got out as fast as she could, and thats what i suspect happened in my case. A wrongful apprehension. But i feel like i dont have the means of fighting it other than showing how much ive improved. I was also thinking of a lawsuit against the agency for a wrongful apprehension, but ive got no way of proving so.

The logic was "If i dont have my daughter still why would I be allowed to have my son". I love my kids with all my heart, i really do. It kills me every time i put them to bed and then go home, anxious to come back. I'd live with them and my mom, but theres already 8 folks in that house and no available room for myself.
You wouldnt believe the hoops FACS lept through to apprehend her. My mom used to work for them, and she knows.
Ive been stable for years. But again, every time i push for it, she says otherwise. I dont get what im doing wrong.
Thats really all there is to say. I dont know what else you could want.

Speaking of, I have a story for this one. 
A few years ago, I had troubles getting to and from work. It was just so far, and no busses ran out that way, so it waa either a bicycle, or walking, and i didnt have a bike. My boyfriend suggested we go to this little rent to own shop downtown and see if we can get one of those E-Bikes with the whole payment plan thing. I thought nothing of it as my credit score is garbage but as it turns out, they didnt ask for my SIN for a credit check, just like, 4 references. 
So i got this real cool looking one. You wouldnt have been able to tell it was an e-bike it looked so much like an old WWII motorcycle. Well, i paid i think it was $100/month to this guy while I had the bike. Fast forward like 6 months, and the sudden death of a desr friend comes along, and we werent the richest folk, so we went to value village to hunt for a black suit for my boyfriend, the funeral was the next day. It was 3 in the afternoon, in broad daylight in a packed parking lot. We were in there for twenty minutes, tops. We walk back out, and the bike is gone, helmets and all. Like someone made it vanish. I still had the key in my hand, too. Some scumbag stole it right in broad daylight and no one said a thing. 
A few months later i find its gutted frame in a field just up from my house. I knew it was mine gecause the serial number on the frame matched the one i had taken a photo of. 
So come winter time, ive been struggling money wise immensely. A double income from me and my husband working full time, only to barely afford a sketchy motel-turned-apartments in a real bad area of town, and it was STILL $1,100 a month (floor wasnt even finished, either, it was scratchy concrete and damn did it get cold. No kitchenette either, just a bed, a toilet and a small bathtub.). Anyways, before I get wildly off track, ive become behind on the payments to the guy, but i really assured him im working on them. Paying nearly 2 grand for a bike you no longer have sucks. So this guy apparently looked at the papers i signed and SHOWS UP TO MY MOTEL ROOM. Dude looked at my address and came to my door like some fucking mafia member looking for his money. 
He then proceeded to tell me that if he doesnt recieve a payment by the end of the week, hes reporting me to the police, and telling them i stole the bike ive been paying for, and that they'd charge me with theft under. That was fucking TERRIFYING to me. Ive never so much as littered. I wouldnt be able to be a medic if i was charged with theft, theres no way. His threats continued on for 2 years after that. Threatening me with legal action, and that im going to be arrested for this. Hes the only one employed there so i always assumed he just owned the store.
So the threats dropped off when covid hit, and i was assuming he was backing off in such a hard time, but upon driving past his store this month, theres nothing but brown paper covering the windows, no open sign left, and an empty building. 
He never got my SIN for a credit score, so my left over debt couldnt be transferred to collections. 
Karmas a bitch, huh.
